# Selectable

> Framework-agnostic, zero-dependency, accessible select/dropdown library.
> A modern replacement for select2 and bootstrap-select: enhances a native
> `<select>` in place, opens its panel in the browser top layer (Popover API),
> and isolates all styling under `--sl-*` tokens so host CSS never breaks it.
> Vanilla TypeScript; ESM/CJS/IIFE + a single CSS file. Version: 0.1.0
> (pre-release, not yet on npm).

Key facts:
- Install: `npm install selectablejs` (soon) + `import "selectablejs/css"`
- Init: `new Selectable(selectElement | selector, options)` — wraps the existing `<select>` (progressive enhancement); or `Selectable.upgrade()` for all `select[data-selectable]`
- The native select stays in the form: submit, FormData, `form.reset()`, and framework bindings (native `change`/`input` are dispatched) keep working
- All CSS variables are `--sl-` prefixed and component-scoped (no `:root` pollution); classes live under `.sl-*`
- Source of truth for the API: `src/core/types.ts` (`SelectableOptions`, `SelectableEventMap`)
